title: Vendor collab quicklog
content:
Quick log / morning brain dump - vendor collab (short checklist + notes)

Context:
- Working with VectorHub (pilot partner) on listing integration (embeddings + endpoint wiring)
- Goal this week: get first successful inference call from their staging model via our hosted API and confirm latency < 200ms p95 for small batch (n=4)

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Confirm API key scoping for vectorhub-staging (asked infra to enable read-only keys) -- follow up w/ SRE (Marcus) by 11:00
- [ ] Run quick tokenization smoke test on sample docs -> need tokenizer config from VectorHub (Elena to share)
- [ ] Validate embedding dims: their model returns 1536 but our catalog expects 1024 -> quick decision: accept 1536 and add mapping for search service, or request 1024 variant from partner
- [ ] Add ephemeral route in console sandbox: "vendor/vectorhub/staging-v1" -> set cache TTL 60s, batching: conservative (max_batch_tokens 1024)

Notes from 09:30 sync call
- Partner: agreed to deliver tokenizer config + sample corpus by EOD Tuesday. Action: Elena to upload to shared folder (TODO)
- Infra: SRE flagged that their model uses FP16 custom kernels; fallback path for CPU must be gated behind private deployment only. That means hosted API will need to route to dedicated pool if we accept FP16 kernel. Marcus to check reserved capacity options and estimated cost impact (ETA tomorrow)
- Security: partner requested to use customer-managed KMS for keys. Need legal + security sign-off. I filed JIRA PRT-492 referencing contract clause.
- Observability: partner wants per-request trace ids in logs. We can expose X-Trace-ID via header; add note to rollout plan for console (small UI change)

Integration checklist (rough, to iterate)
- API access: create scoped key -> confirm scopes (embeddings:read, inference:invoke) -> test call
- Model metadata: name, dims, tokenization, quantization flags -> store in model-catalog mapping
- Endpoint wiring: route config + fallback policies -> decide dedicated vs hosted path
- Latency testing: create small benchmark harness (n=50 calls, n=4 batch) -> record p50/p95/p99
- Cost estimate: per-token cost estimate + reserved capacity uplift if needed
- Docs: one-pager for partner onboarding in marketplace -> minimal steps, supported modes, troubleshooting
- Legal/Security: NDA/contract signatures + KMS decision + data retention settings

Open questions / Flags
- Tokenizer mismatch: do we accept variable embedding_dims on listing? Pros: faster time-to-list. Cons: downstream search infra complexity. Preference leaning: accept and add a shim translator for search indexing. Need signoff from search infra (add to ticket).
- FP16 kernels: can hosted API support resumed gated path with fallback to quantized 8-bit? Cost may spike. If partner insists on FP16, suggest dedicated offering only.
- SLA ask: partner requested 99.9% for first 6 months. Need product ops and pricing input.

Micro-tasks (quick wins)
- ping Elena for tokenizer config (slack)
- create local script to hit /v1/embeddings with their sample: vendor_emb_test.py -> run by EOD
- stub the console route so partner can click and see 'connected' state even before full plumbing
- update marketplace draft one-pager with explicit supported embedding dims and routing notes

Evening check (to self)
- Gather raw timings from harness -> paste into this doc (timestamps + notes)
- If latency p95 < 200ms, prepare alpha note for partner with next steps and ask for feedback call

Random reminders (notes to self)
- Don't forget to file the KMS approval in security portal (I always forget this step)
- Keep the onboarding one-pager under 1 page, bullet heavy (partners appreciate brevity)
- Use example cURL snippets not SDK-only, partner ops prefers simple reproducible commands

End-of-day TODO (light)
- [ ] Run harness, capture p95/p99, paste results here
- [ ] Upload tokenizer config from partner into drive link and update linked_artifacts
- [ ] Draft Slack update for #partner-onboarding with short status + blockers

Small wins log (today)
- Got verbal confirmation from partner that sample corpus is ready
- Spinner: managed to reproduce one failing tokenization edge-case locally (emoji sequence); made note to request normalized input from partner

Timestamp: 2026-03-13 09:12 PST
Signed-off: Aisha
